answer: In arXiv 2310.17688, 'frontier AI' is characterized as general-purpose AI models and systems whose performance is no more than a year behind the state-of-the-art on a broad suite of general capability benchmarks. These systems are defined in terms of their capabilities rather than characteristics like computational power or money spent on research and development, as capabilities are more directly related to the risks resulting from the production and deployment of frontier AI systems.
